formal_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ) (L : Submodule ℂ (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → ∀ t ∈ L, (∑ a, MvPolynomial.eval y (MvPolynomial.pderiv a (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m)) * t a = 0) ∧ (∑ a, ∑ b, MvPolynomial.eval y (MvPolynomial.pderiv a (MvPolynomial.pderiv b (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m))) * t a * t b = 0)
plain_statement: If perm_m(y + t) = 0 for every t in a linear space L, then for every t in L the gradient of perm_m at y kills t and the Hessian quadratic form of perm_m at y vanishes at t: the coefficients of s and s^2 in the zero polynomial s -> perm(y + s t). Second formal reduction under L-gct-036, requested by seat-gct-1.
title: First and second order conditions on a linear space through a zero y inside the permanent hypersurface
